content.text:
**Finding: compliant** (preferred position) — no redline proposed.

- **§ 12.3** affirmatively confirms Customer is unrestricted as to developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, or operating in any field or territory, and that no exclusivity/non-compete/MFC/minimum-volume/no-hire commitment has been made.
- **§ 12.4** is a competition restriction running *against* the Vendor (no directly competing analytics service during the term) — it benefits us, so it is not flagged.
- **§ 24** likewise restricts Vendor from assigning to a Customer competitor.
- **§ 13.4** contains only standard misuse/reverse-engineering limits, not a field-of-use or competitive covenant.

No buried covenant was found in Customer Responsibilities, Access Rights/Licence, Compliance, or General.
